label: Claim Kind
description: What a claim on a case reserves it for. A new kind is a new term here, plus (optionally) a CLAIM_RULE document for it; no template or code change. A kind without a rule document gets the gateway's defaults: one holder, no exclusions, a 60-minute lease.

terms.label: Respond
terms.description: Writing a response (analysis) to the case.

terms.label: Fix
terms.description: Fixing what a review of an implementation found.
